#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Docker Volumes from LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# Usage: ./backup-docker-volumes.sh <container_id> [backup_dir]
#
# Exports all Docker volumes from an LXC container to tar.gz archives.
# Stops Docker compose stack to ensure consistent backup.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

VMID="${1:-}"
BACKUP_DIR="${2:-/tank/backups/migration}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-homelab}"

if [[ -z "$VMID" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <container_id> [backup_dir]"
    echo "Example: $0 502 /tank/backups/migration"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Backing up Docker volumes from LXC $VMID ==="
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"

# Create backup directory on Proxmox host
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "mkdir -p ${BACKUP_DIR}"

# Stop Docker compose stack for consistent backup
echo "Stopping Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose stop'" || true

# Get list of Docker volumes
echo "Getting list of Docker volumes..."
VOLUMES=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker volume ls -q" || echo "")

if [[ -z "$VOLUMES" ]]; then
    echo "No Docker volumes found in container $VMID"
else
    echo "Found volumes: $VOLUMES"

    # Backup each volume
    for vol in $VOLUMES; do
        echo "Backing up volume: $vol"

        # Create backup inside container using alpine
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker run --rm \
            -v ${vol}:/source:ro \
            -v /tmp/backup:/backup \
            alpine tar czf /backup/${vol}.tar.gz -C /source ."

        # Copy backup from container to Proxmox host backup dir
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"

        # Clean up temp file in container
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz"

        echo "  -> Saved to ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"
    done
fi

# Also backup the /config directory (compose files, app data)
echo "Backing up /config directory..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- tar czf /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz -C / config" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-config.tar.gz" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz" || true

# Restart Docker compose stack
echo "Restarting Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose up -d'" || true

echo ""
echo "=== Backup complete ==="
echo "Backup files:"
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "ls -lh ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*" 2>/dev/null || echo "No backup files found"

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure homepage.env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.homepage_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Homepage - Main Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    network_mode: host
    env_file:
      - homepage.env
    environment:
      PUID: 1000

      - ./homepage:/app/config

    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Dashy - Alternative Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./dashy:/app/user-data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Glances - System Monitoring API
  # ==========================================================================
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances

      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }
}

# 1Password Provider Configuration

# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.

#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }
}

file.content:
# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  content     = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT
  destination = "${var.target_path}/portainer-edge.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/portainer-edge.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

file.content:
services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Homepage - Main Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    network_mode: host
    env_file:
      - homepage.env
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev,homepage.tailnet.rambtech.dev
    volumes:
      - ./homepage:/app/config
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Dashy - Alternative Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./dashy:/app/user-data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Glances - System Monitoring API
  # ==========================================================================
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances
    pid: host
    environment:
      - GLANCES_OPT=-w
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.24.1
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    env_file:
      - portainer-edge.env
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Homepage - Main Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    network_mode: host
    env_file:
      - homepage.env
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev,homepage.tailnet.rambtech.dev
    volumes:
      - ./homepage:/app/config
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Dashy - Alternative Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./dashy:/app/user-data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Glances - System Monitoring API
  # ==========================================================================
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances
    pid: host
    environment:
      - GLANCES_OPT=-w
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.24.1
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    env_file:
      - portainer-edge.env
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/portainer-edge.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/portainer-edge.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# Container ID: 202

#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authelia LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 202
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authelia Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authelia"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

# Authelia - Centralized Authentication
# https://www.authelia.com/

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key
      # OIDC env vars - uncomment when enabling OIDC clients
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_HMAC_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/oidc_hmac_secret
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE: /secrets/oidc_private_key
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer_agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:

    depends_on:

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Unprivileged LXC containers** with Docker nesting (`nesting=1, keyctl=1, fuse=0`)
- **Portainer Edge Agents** - outbound-only connections to Portainer (no exposed port 9001)
- **1Password CLI/Terraform provider** for secret management
- **filesync provider** (`darshan-rambhia/filesync`) for syncing files to LXC containers
- **Docker Compose `.env` auto-loading** - Docker Compose automatically loads `.env` files for variable substitution
- **EDGE_KEY format**: `<api_url>|<tunnel_url>|<fingerprint>|<endpoint_id>`
- **Edge Agent env vars**: Must use `EDGE_ID` and `EDGE_KEY` (not `PORTAINER_EDGE_ID`)

### `tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf`
**Purpose**: Core module for Docker-based LXC deployments - modified to support Edge Agent credential injection

```hcl
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# Docker Compose automatically loads .env files for variable substitution.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container as .env (Docker Compose auto-loads this)
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}
```

**Purpose**: 1Password integration for Edge credentials

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# In locals block:
  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }

content.content:
# Authelia - Centralized Authentication
# https://www.authelia.com/

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key
      # OIDC env vars - uncomment when enabling OIDC clients
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_HMAC_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/oidc_hmac_secret
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE: /secrets/oidc_private_key
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-authelia
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:
  portainer_agent_data:

# =============================================================================
# Obsidian LiveSync Server - CouchDB for Obsidian note synchronization
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 503
# IP: 10.100.5.103
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module for deploying CouchDB as the sync backend.
# Accessible via Traefik at obsidian.homelab.rambtech.dev (internal) and
# obsidian.rambtech.dev (public via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - CouchDB Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "obsidian_sync" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "obsidian-sync"
}

locals {
  # CouchDB credentials from 1Password
  couchdb_user     = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.username
  couchdb_password = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.password
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 503
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 8
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obsidian Sync Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "obsidian_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "obsidian-sync"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources - CouchDB is lightweight
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.couchdb_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Obsidian LiveSync"
  service_description = "CouchDB server for Obsidian note synchronization across devices"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}"
    couchdb  = "http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "CouchDB", port = 5984, info = "Database & Fauxton UI" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Obsidian LiveSync Setup

**Initialize CouchDB (first time only):**
```bash
# Run the official init script
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync/main/utils/couchdb/couchdb-init.sh | bash
```

**Or manually via Fauxton UI:**
1. Open http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils
2. Login with credentials from 1Password
3. Setup → Configure as Single Node
4. Create database: obsidian-vault

**Obsidian Plugin Setup:**
1. Install "Self-hosted LiveSync" plugin
2. Remote URI: https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}
3. Username/Password: from 1Password "obsidian-sync"
4. Database: obsidian-vault

## Quick Commands

```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f couchdb
cd /config && docker compose restart couchdb
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=obsidian-sync` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["obsidian", "sync", "couchdb", "notes"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Internal route (for homelab access)
module "obsidian_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "obsidian"
  backend_url = "http://${module.obsidian_sync.ip_address}:5984"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile/remote access)
  public_domain = "obsidian.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.obsidian_sync]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.obsidian_sync.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal      = module.obsidian_route.internal_url
    public        = module.obsidian_route.public_url
    couchdb_admin = "http://${module.obsidian_sync.ip_address}:5984/_utils"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.obsidian_route.remote_config_path
}

# Obsidian LiveSync - CouchDB Server
# https://github.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync

name: obsidian-sync

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # CouchDB - Obsidian LiveSync Backend
  # ==========================================================================
  couchdb:
    image: couchdb:3.3.3
    container_name: obsidian-livesync
    environment:
      - COUCHDB_USER=${COUCHDB_USER}
      - COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${COUCHDB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - couchdb-data:/opt/couchdb/data
      # Mount directory (not file) - CouchDB needs to write docker.ini here
      - ./couchdb-config:/opt/couchdb/etc/local.d
    ports:
      - "5984:5984"
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:5984/_up"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  couchdb-data:

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Docker Volumes from LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# Usage: ./backup-docker-volumes.sh <container_id> [backup_dir]
#
# Exports all Docker volumes from an LXC container to tar.gz archives.
# Stops Docker compose stack to ensure consistent backup.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

VMID="${1:-}"
BACKUP_DIR="${2:-/tank/backups/migration}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-homelab}"

if [[ -z "$VMID" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <container_id> [backup_dir]"
    echo "Example: $0 502 /tank/backups/migration"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Backing up Docker volumes from LXC $VMID ==="
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"

# Create backup directory on Proxmox host
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "mkdir -p ${BACKUP_DIR}"

# Check available space on backup destination
echo "Checking available space..."
BACKUP_AVAIL_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "df ${BACKUP_DIR} 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
BACKUP_AVAIL_GB=$((BACKUP_AVAIL_KB / 1024 / 1024))
echo "Available space on backup destination: ${BACKUP_AVAIL_GB}GB"

# Estimate Docker volumes size (rough estimate from container)
DOCKER_SIZE_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- du -sk /var/lib/docker/volumes 2>/dev/null | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
DOCKER_SIZE_GB=$((DOCKER_SIZE_KB / 1024 / 1024))
echo "Estimated Docker volumes size: ${DOCKER_SIZE_GB}GB (compressed will be smaller)"

# Also check container's /tmp space (used for staging)
CONTAINER_TMP_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
CONTAINER_TMP_MB=$((CONTAINER_TMP_KB / 1024))
echo "Available space in container /tmp (staging): ${CONTAINER_TMP_MB}MB"

# Warn if backup destination has less than estimated size
if [[ $BACKUP_AVAIL_KB -lt $DOCKER_SIZE_KB ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: Backup destination may have insufficient space!"
    echo "   Available: ${BACKUP_AVAIL_GB}GB, Estimated needed: ${DOCKER_SIZE_GB}GB"
    echo ""
    read -p "Continue with backup anyway? [y/N] " -n 1 -r
    echo
    if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        echo "Aborting backup."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Stop Docker compose stack for consistent backup
echo "Stopping Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose stop'" || true

# Get list of Docker volumes
echo "Getting list of Docker volumes..."
VOLUMES=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker volume ls -q" || echo "")

if [[ -z "$VOLUMES" ]]; then
    echo "No Docker volumes found in container $VMID"
else
    echo "Found volumes: $VOLUMES"

    # Backup each volume
    for vol in $VOLUMES; do
        echo "Backing up volume: $vol"

        # Create backup inside container using alpine
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker run --rm \
            -v ${vol}:/source:ro \
            -v /tmp/backup:/backup \
            alpine tar czf /backup/${vol}.tar.gz -C /source ."

        # Copy backup from container to Proxmox host backup dir
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"

        # Clean up temp file in container
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz"

        echo "  -> Saved to ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"
    done
fi

# Also backup the /config directory (compose files, app data)
echo "Backing up /config directory..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- tar czf /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz -C / config" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-config.tar.gz" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz" || true

# Restart Docker compose stack
echo "Restarting Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose up -d'" || true

echo ""
echo "=== Backup complete ==="
echo "Backup files:"
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "ls -lh ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*" 2>/dev/null || echo "No backup files found"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Restore Docker Volumes to LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# Usage: ./restore-docker-volumes.sh <container_id> [backup_dir]
#
# Restores Docker volumes from tar.gz archives to an LXC container.
# Should be run after container recreation.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

VMID="${1:-}"
BACKUP_DIR="${2:-/tank/backups/migration}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-homelab}"

if [[ -z "$VMID" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <container_id> [backup_dir]"
    echo "Example: $0 502 /tank/backups/migration"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Restoring Docker volumes to LXC $VMID ==="
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"

# Check container is running
if ! ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct status $VMID" | grep -q running; then
    echo "Starting container $VMID..."
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct start $VMID"
    sleep 10  # Wait for container to fully boot
fi

# Wait for Docker to be ready
echo "Waiting for Docker daemon..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker info" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Docker is ready"
        break
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Restore /config directory first (contains docker-compose.yml)
CONFIG_BACKUP="${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-config.tar.gz"
if ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "test -f ${CONFIG_BACKUP}"; then
    echo "Restoring /config directory..."
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct push $VMID ${CONFIG_BACKUP} /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz"
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- tar xzf /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz -C /"
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz"
    echo "  -> Restored /config"
else
    echo "No config backup found at ${CONFIG_BACKUP}"
fi

# Get list of volume backups
echo "Looking for volume backups..."
VOLUME_BACKUPS=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "ls ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -v config.tar.gz" || echo "")

if [[ -z "$VOLUME_BACKUPS" ]]; then
    echo "No volume backups found for container $VMID"
else
    # Check available space in container's /tmp before restoring
    echo "Checking available space in container..."
    AVAILABLE_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
    AVAILABLE_MB=$((AVAILABLE_KB / 1024))
    echo "Available space in /tmp: ${AVAILABLE_MB}MB"

    # Calculate total backup size
    TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "du -c ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | grep total | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
    TOTAL_BACKUP_MB=$((TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE / 1024))
    echo "Total backup size: ${TOTAL_BACKUP_MB}MB"

    # Warn if insufficient space (need at least backup size for staging)
    if [[ $AVAILABLE_KB -lt $TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE ]]; then
        echo ""
        echo "⚠️  WARNING: Insufficient space in /tmp for restoration!"
        echo "   Available: ${AVAILABLE_MB}MB, Required: ~${TOTAL_BACKUP_MB}MB"
        echo ""
        echo "Options:"
        echo "  1. Increase container rootfs size"
        echo "  2. Mount external storage for staging"
        echo "  3. Restore volumes one at a time (continuing with smaller backups)"
        echo ""
        read -p "Continue with restoration anyway? [y/N] " -n 1 -r
        echo
        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo "Aborting restoration."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi

    for archive in $VOLUME_BACKUPS; do
        # Extract volume name from filename (VMID-volumename.tar.gz)
        filename=$(basename "$archive")
        vol=$(echo "$filename" | sed "s/${VMID}-//" | sed 's/.tar.gz//')

        # Check individual archive size before restoring
        ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "du -k ${archive} 2>/dev/null | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
        ARCHIVE_MB=$((ARCHIVE_SIZE / 1024))

        # Re-check available space for each volume
        CURRENT_AVAILABLE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")

        if [[ $CURRENT_AVAILABLE -lt $ARCHIVE_SIZE ]]; then
            echo ""
            echo "⚠️  SKIPPING $vol: Archive size (${ARCHIVE_MB}MB) exceeds available /tmp space ($((CURRENT_AVAILABLE / 1024))MB)"
            echo "   To restore this volume manually:"
            echo "   1. Mount additional storage to container"
            echo "   2. Copy ${archive} to mounted path"
            echo "   3. Extract to Docker volume"
            continue
        fi

        echo "Restoring volume: $vol (${ARCHIVE_MB}MB)"

        # Push archive to container
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct push $VMID ${archive} /tmp/${vol}.tar.gz"

        # Create volume if it doesn't exist
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker volume create $vol" 2>/dev/null || true

        # Restore volume contents using alpine
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker run --rm \
            -v ${vol}:/dest \
            -v /tmp:/backup \
            alpine sh -c 'cd /dest && tar xzf /backup/${vol}.tar.gz'"

        # Clean up temp file
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/${vol}.tar.gz"

        echo "  -> Restored volume: $vol"
    done
fi

# Start Docker compose stack
echo "Starting Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose up -d'" || true

echo ""
echo "=== Restore complete ==="
echo "Docker containers:"
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker ps"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Docker Volumes from LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# Usage: ./backup-docker-volumes.sh <container_id> [backup_dir]
#
# Exports all Docker volumes from an LXC container to tar.gz archives.
# Stops Docker compose stack to ensure consistent backup.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

VMID="${1:-}"
BACKUP_DIR="${2:-/tank/backups/migration}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-homelab}"

if [[ -z "$VMID" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <container_id> [backup_dir]"
    echo "Example: $0 502 /tank/backups/migration"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Backing up Docker volumes from LXC $VMID ==="
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"

# Create backup directory on Proxmox host
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "mkdir -p ${BACKUP_DIR}"

# Check available space on backup destination
echo "Checking available space..."
BACKUP_AVAIL_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "df ${BACKUP_DIR} 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
BACKUP_AVAIL_GB=$((BACKUP_AVAIL_KB / 1024 / 1024))
echo "Available space on backup destination: ${BACKUP_AVAIL_GB}GB"

# Estimate Docker volumes size (rough estimate from container)
DOCKER_SIZE_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- du -sk /var/lib/docker/volumes 2>/dev/null | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
DOCKER_SIZE_GB=$((DOCKER_SIZE_KB / 1024 / 1024))
echo "Estimated Docker volumes size: ${DOCKER_SIZE_GB}GB (compressed will be smaller)"

# Also check container's /tmp space (used for staging)
CONTAINER_TMP_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
CONTAINER_TMP_MB=$((CONTAINER_TMP_KB / 1024))
echo "Available space in container /tmp (staging): ${CONTAINER_TMP_MB}MB"

# Warn if backup destination has less than estimated size
if [[ $BACKUP_AVAIL_KB -lt $DOCKER_SIZE_KB ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: Backup destination may have insufficient space!"
    echo "   Available: ${BACKUP_AVAIL_GB}GB, Estimated needed: ${DOCKER_SIZE_GB}GB"
    echo ""
    read -p "Continue with backup anyway? [y/N] " -n 1 -r
    echo
    if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        echo "Aborting backup."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Stop Docker compose stack for consistent backup
echo "Stopping Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose stop'" || true

# Get list of Docker volumes
echo "Getting list of Docker volumes..."
VOLUMES=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker volume ls -q" || echo "")

if [[ -z "$VOLUMES" ]]; then
    echo "No Docker volumes found in container $VMID"
else
    echo "Found volumes: $VOLUMES"

    # Backup each volume
    for vol in $VOLUMES; do
        echo "Backing up volume: $vol"

        # Create backup inside container using alpine
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker run --rm \
            -v ${vol}:/source:ro \
            -v /tmp/backup:/backup \
            alpine tar czf /backup/${vol}.tar.gz -C /source ."

        # Copy backup from container to Proxmox host backup dir
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"

        # Clean up temp file in container
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/backup/${vol}.tar.gz"

        echo "  -> Saved to ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-${vol}.tar.gz"
    done
fi

# Also backup the /config directory (compose files, app data)
echo "Backing up /config directory..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- tar czf /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz -C / config" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct pull $VMID /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-config.tar.gz" || true
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz" || true

# Restart Docker compose stack
echo "Restarting Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose up -d'" || true

echo ""
echo "=== Backup complete ==="
echo "Backup files:"
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "ls -lh ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*" 2>/dev/null || echo "No backup files found"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Restore Docker Volumes to LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# Usage: ./restore-docker-volumes.sh <container_id> [backup_dir]
#
# Restores Docker volumes from tar.gz archives to an LXC container.
# Should be run after container recreation.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

VMID="${1:-}"
BACKUP_DIR="${2:-/tank/backups/migration}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-homelab}"

if [[ -z "$VMID" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <container_id> [backup_dir]"
    echo "Example: $0 502 /tank/backups/migration"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Restoring Docker volumes to LXC $VMID ==="
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"

# Check container is running
if ! ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct status $VMID" | grep -q running; then
    echo "Starting container $VMID..."
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct start $VMID"
    sleep 10  # Wait for container to fully boot
fi

# Wait for Docker to be ready
echo "Waiting for Docker daemon..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker info" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Docker is ready"
        break
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Restore /config directory first (contains docker-compose.yml)
CONFIG_BACKUP="${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-config.tar.gz"
if ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "test -f ${CONFIG_BACKUP}"; then
    echo "Restoring /config directory..."
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct push $VMID ${CONFIG_BACKUP} /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz"
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- tar xzf /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz -C /"
    ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/config-backup.tar.gz"
    echo "  -> Restored /config"
else
    echo "No config backup found at ${CONFIG_BACKUP}"
fi

# Get list of volume backups
echo "Looking for volume backups..."
VOLUME_BACKUPS=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "ls ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -v config.tar.gz" || echo "")

if [[ -z "$VOLUME_BACKUPS" ]]; then
    echo "No volume backups found for container $VMID"
else
    # Check available space in container's /tmp before restoring
    echo "Checking available space in container..."
    AVAILABLE_KB=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")
    AVAILABLE_MB=$((AVAILABLE_KB / 1024))
    echo "Available space in /tmp: ${AVAILABLE_MB}MB"

    # Calculate total backup size
    TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "du -c ${BACKUP_DIR}/${VMID}-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | grep total | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
    TOTAL_BACKUP_MB=$((TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE / 1024))
    echo "Total backup size: ${TOTAL_BACKUP_MB}MB"

    # Warn if insufficient space (need at least backup size for staging)
    if [[ $AVAILABLE_KB -lt $TOTAL_BACKUP_SIZE ]]; then
        echo ""
        echo "⚠️  WARNING: Insufficient space in /tmp for restoration!"
        echo "   Available: ${AVAILABLE_MB}MB, Required: ~${TOTAL_BACKUP_MB}MB"
        echo ""
        echo "Options:"
        echo "  1. Increase container rootfs size"
        echo "  2. Mount external storage for staging"
        echo "  3. Restore volumes one at a time (continuing with smaller backups)"
        echo ""
        read -p "Continue with restoration anyway? [y/N] " -n 1 -r
        echo
        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo "Aborting restoration."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi

    for archive in $VOLUME_BACKUPS; do
        # Extract volume name from filename (VMID-volumename.tar.gz)
        filename=$(basename "$archive")
        vol=$(echo "$filename" | sed "s/${VMID}-//" | sed 's/.tar.gz//')

        # Check individual archive size before restoring
        ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "du -k ${archive} 2>/dev/null | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "0")
        ARCHIVE_MB=$((ARCHIVE_SIZE / 1024))

        # Re-check available space for each volume
        CURRENT_AVAILABLE=$(ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- df /tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print \$4}'" || echo "0")

        if [[ $CURRENT_AVAILABLE -lt $ARCHIVE_SIZE ]]; then
            echo ""
            echo "⚠️  SKIPPING $vol: Archive size (${ARCHIVE_MB}MB) exceeds available /tmp space ($((CURRENT_AVAILABLE / 1024))MB)"
            echo "   To restore this volume manually:"
            echo "   1. Mount additional storage to container"
            echo "   2. Copy ${archive} to mounted path"
            echo "   3. Extract to Docker volume"
            continue
        fi

        echo "Restoring volume: $vol (${ARCHIVE_MB}MB)"

        # Push archive to container
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct push $VMID ${archive} /tmp/${vol}.tar.gz"

        # Create volume if it doesn't exist
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker volume create $vol" 2>/dev/null || true

        # Restore volume contents using alpine
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker run --rm \
            -v ${vol}:/dest \
            -v /tmp:/backup \
            alpine sh -c 'cd /dest && tar xzf /backup/${vol}.tar.gz'"

        # Clean up temp file
        ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- rm -f /tmp/${vol}.tar.gz"

        echo "  -> Restored volume: $vol"
    done
fi

# Start Docker compose stack
echo "Starting Docker services..."
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- bash -c 'cd /config && docker compose up -d'" || true

echo ""
echo "=== Restore complete ==="
echo "Docker containers:"
ssh "root@${PROXMOX_HOST}" "pct exec $VMID -- docker ps"
