# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 503

# Accessible via Traefik at obsidian.homelab.rambtech.dev (internal) and
# obsidian.rambtech.dev (public via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - CouchDB Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "obsidian_sync" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "obsidian-sync"
}

locals {
  # CouchDB credentials from 1Password
  couchdb_user     = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.username
  couchdb_password = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.password
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}

  file_permission = "0600"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 503
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 8

module "obsidian_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

# Obsidian LiveSync - CouchDB Server
# https://github.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync

name: obsidian-sync

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # CouchDB - Obsidian LiveSync Backend
  # ==========================================================================
  couchdb:
    image: couchdb:3.3.3
    container_name: obsidian-livesync
    environment:
      - COUCHDB_USER=${COUCHDB_USER}
      - COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${COUCHDB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - couchdb-data:/opt/couchdb/data
      # Mount directory (not file) - CouchDB needs to write docker.ini here
      - ./couchdb-config:/opt/couchdb/etc/local.d
    ports:
      - "5984:5984"
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:5984/_up"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-obsidian-sync
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  couchdb-data:
  portainer_agent_data:

I see the issue. The Obsidian Sync app generates a `.env` file in `deploy/.env` for CouchDB credentials, and the docker-lxc module syncs all files from `deploy/` to `/config`. Then the module also creates its own `.env` with Edge credentials and syncs it to `/config/.env`, overwriting the CouchDB credentials.

We need to either:
1. Exclude `.env` from the deploy files sync in docker-lxc module
2. Or merge the credentials into a single .env file at the app level

Option 2 is cleaner. Let me update the obsidian-sync app to include both CouchDB and Edge credentials in its .env:

# =============================================================================
# Obsidian LiveSync Server - CouchDB for Obsidian note synchronization
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 503
# IP: 10.100.5.103
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module for deploying CouchDB as the sync backend.
# Accessible via Traefik at obsidian.homelab.rambtech.dev (internal) and
# obsidian.rambtech.dev (public via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - CouchDB Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "obsidian_sync" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "obsidian-sync"
}

locals {
  # CouchDB credentials from 1Password
  couchdb_user     = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.username
  couchdb_password = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.password
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 503
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 8
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obsidian Sync Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "obsidian_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "obsidian-sync"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources - CouchDB is lightweight
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.couchdb_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Obsidian LiveSync"
  service_description = "CouchDB server for Obsidian note synchronization across devices"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}"
    couchdb  = "http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "CouchDB", port = 5984, info = "Database & Fauxton UI" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT

4. Create database: obsidian-vault

**Obsidian Plugin Setup:**
1. Install "Self-hosted LiveSync" plugin
2. Remote URI: https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}
3. Username/Password: from 1Password "obsidian-sync"

```bash

```

# =============================================================================
# Obsidian LiveSync Server - CouchDB for Obsidian note synchronization
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 503
# IP: 10.100.5.103
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module for deploying CouchDB as the sync backend.
# Accessible via Traefik at obsidian.homelab.rambtech.dev (internal) and
# obsidian.rambtech.dev (public via Cloudflare tunnel for mobile access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - CouchDB Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "obsidian_sync" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "obsidian-sync"
}

locals {
  # CouchDB credentials from 1Password
  couchdb_user     = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.username
  couchdb_password = data.onepassword_item.obsidian_sync.password
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
# NOTE: This file is excluded from filesync (via exclude_patterns) because
# the docker-lxc module handles .env generation for Edge credentials.
# We'll set portainer_edge_id/key to empty so the module doesn't create a separate .env,
# and we'll include both CouchDB and Edge credentials in this file instead.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB + Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# CouchDB credentials (from 1Password: obsidian-sync)
COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-obsidian-sync)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 503
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 8
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obsidian Sync Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "obsidian_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "obsidian-sync"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources - CouchDB is lightweight
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.couchdb_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Obsidian LiveSync"
  service_description = "CouchDB server for Obsidian note synchronization across devices"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://obsidian.${var.domain_public}"
    couchdb  = "http://${local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync}:5984/_utils"
  }

  services = [

    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT

# Run the official init script

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:latest
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:latest
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.11-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================

# IP: 192.168.1.229

# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://192.168.1.229:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://192.168.1.229:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

# View OTEL collector logs

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:latest
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:latest
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.11-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The conversation is summarized below:
Analysis:
Let me chronologically analyze the conversation to capture all technical details, decisions, and current state.

## Session Overview
This is a continuation session focused on migrating Docker-in-LXC containers from privileged to unprivileged mode, while also converting from standard Portainer Agents (port 9001) to Edge Agents (outbound-only connections).

## Chronological Analysis

### Previous Session Context (from summary)
- n8n (502) and OpenWebUI (501) already migrated
- Pattern established: backup → remove from state → destroy → apply → restore → start
- User explicitly told not to use `scp` or `rsync` - must use OpenTofu filesync

### Current Session - Authelia (202) Continuation
1. **Started mid-migration** - docker-compose.yml filesync removed from state, needed to re-sync
2. **Re-planned and applied** - synced updated docker-compose.yml with Edge Agent config
3. **Started containers** - `docker compose up -d`
4. **Verified success**: unprivileged=1, Edge Agent connected, Authelia responding with HTTP 200

### Obsidian Sync (503) Migration
1. **User feedback about backup script**: "the docker compose file that we backup will always be the wrong one. so maybe we shouldn't put it in the back up to be restored to something again"
2. **Updated backup-docker-volumes.sh**: Added exclusions for docker-compose.yml, .env, .gitignore
3. **Updated restore-docker-volumes.sh**: 
   - Updated comments about excluding OpenTofu-managed files
   - Removed auto-start of Docker compose at end (need OpenTofu to sync first)
   - Added "NEXT STEPS" instructions in output

4. **Updated main.tf**: Changed `unprivileged = false` to `unprivileged = true`
5. **Updated docker-compose.yml**: Replaced portainer-agent with portainer-edge-agent
6. **User provided credentials**: `EDGE_ID=bc41da43-1beb-40df-86da-c32084d12a25`

7. **Issue discovered**: Obsidian Sync generates its own `.env` for CouchDB credentials, but docker-lxc module creates separate `.env` for Edge credentials, overwriting CouchDB vars

8. **Solution**: Modified `local_sensitive_file.couchdb_env` to include BOTH CouchDB AND Edge credentials, and removed `portainer_edge_id/key` from module call so docker-lxc module doesn't create its own .env

9. **SSH key mismatch error** - Fixed with ssh-keygen -R and ssh-keyscan

10. **Migration completed successfully** - unprivileged=1, Edge Agent connected

### Monitoring (500) Migration
1. **Updated main.tf**: Changed `unprivileged = false` to `unprivileged = true`, updated services list
2. **Updated .env.tpl**: Added PORTAINER_EDGE_ID and PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY variables
3. **Updated templatefile call**: Added portainer_edge_id and portainer_edge_key parameters
4. **Updated docker-compose.yml**: Replaced portainer-agent with portainer-edge-agent
5. **Backup completed**: 6 Docker volumes backed up
6. **User provided credentials**: `EDGE_ID=3250a308-d2c9-40b3-b013-202697b7c6ca`
7. **Updated 1Password**: Added credentials to portainer-edge-monitoring
8. **SSH key mismatch** - Fixed same way
9. **Migration completed** - All 9 containers running, Edge Agent connected, unprivileged=1

## Key Files Modified

### Migration Scripts
- `scripts/migration/backup-docker-volumes.sh` - Added exclusions for OpenTofu-managed files
- `scripts/migration/restore-docker-volumes.sh` - Removed auto-start, added NEXT STEPS

### Obsidian Sync
- `tofu/apps/obsidian-sync/main.tf` - unprivileged=true, combined .env approach
- `tofu/apps/obsidian-sync/deploy/docker-compose.yml` - Edge Agent config

### Monitoring
- `tofu/apps/monitoring/main.tf` - unprivileged=true, Edge credentials in templatefile
- `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/.env.tpl` - Added Edge credential vars
- `tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/docker-compose.yml` - Edge Agent config

### Already Modified (from previous session/earlier)
- `tofu/apps/dashboards/main.tf`
- `tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/docker-compose.yml`
- `tofu/apps/authelia/main.tf`
- `tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/docker-compose.yml`
- `tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf` - Added portainer_edge_env resources
- `tofu/modules/docker-lxc/variables.tf` - Added Edge credential variables
- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Added portainer_edge data source and locals

## Completed Migrations
1. Dashboards (201) - COMPLETED
2. Authelia (202) - COMPLETED
3. Obsidian Sync (503) - COMPLETED
4. Monitoring (500) - COMPLETED

## Remaining Migrations
5. Jellyfin (401) - GPU passthrough required
6. Immich (304) - GPU passthrough required
7. Portainer (100) - Management plane

## User Messages
1. "the docker compose file that we backup will always be the wrong one. so maybe we shouldn't put it in the back up to be restored to something again" - Led to updating backup/restore scripts
2. "Monitoring-lxc: EDGE_ID=3250a308-d2c9-40b3-b013-202697b7c6ca EDGE_KEY=..."

## Errors and Fixes

The user is continuing a homelab security hardening project with two main goals:
1. **Convert privileged Docker-in-LXC containers to unprivileged mode** - Proxmox's `privileged` flag is immutable after creation, requiring destroy/recreate workflow
2. **Migrate from standard Portainer Agents (port 9001) to Edge Agents** - Outbound-only connections, no exposed ports, credentials managed via 1Password

- **Unprivileged LXC containers** with Docker nesting (`nesting=1, keyctl=1`)
- **Portainer Edge Agents** - outbound-only WebSocket tunnel to Portainer server
- **1Password CLI/Terraform provider** for secret management
- **filesync provider** (`darshan-rambhia/filesync`) for syncing files to LXC containers

### `tofu/apps/obsidian-sync/main.tf`
**Importance**: Special handling - generates combined .env with both CouchDB AND Edge credentials.
```hcl

# NOTE: This file is excluded from filesync (via exclude_patterns) because
# the docker-lxc module handles .env generation for Edge credentials.
# We'll set portainer_edge_id/key to empty so the module doesn't create a separate .env,
# and we'll include both CouchDB and Edge credentials in this file instead.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "couchdb_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# CouchDB + Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# CouchDB credentials (from 1Password: obsidian-sync)
COUCHDB_USER=${local.couchdb_user}
COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${local.couchdb_password}

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-obsidian-sync)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["obsidian-sync"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

module "obsidian_sync" {
  # ...
  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app
  # generates its own .env file that includes both CouchDB and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate .env
  # that would overwrite our combined one.
  # ...
}
```

# =============================================================================
# Jellyfin LXC - Media Server
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 401
# IP: 192.168.1.226

module "jellyfin" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "jellyfin"
  container_id = 401
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DLNA/casting)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  cores  = 4
  memory = 8192
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 32

  unprivileged = false

  # Note: Mount point for /data/library must be added manually via Proxmox SSH
  # The API token doesn't have permission to add bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  # Run this after container creation:
  # ssh root@homelab "pct set 401 -mp0 /tank/data/library,mp=/data/library"
  mount_points = []

  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  service_name        = "Jellyfin"
  service_description = "Media server for movies, TV shows, and music"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.226:8096"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Jellyfin", port = 8096, info = "Media server UI" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands
**View logs:** cd /config && docker compose logs -f jellyfin
**Restart:** cd /config && docker compose restart jellyfin
EOT

  tags = ["jellyfin", "media"]
}

module "jellyfin_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellyfin"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:8096"

  internal_domain = "jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellystat - Jellyfin statistics dashboard
module "jellystat_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellystat"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "jellystat.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Has built-in auth, only need security headers and internal access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "internal-only"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellyseerr/Requests - Media request management
module "requests_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "requests"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:5055"

  internal_domain = "requests.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "requests.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["public-security"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

output "container_id" { value = module.jellyfin.container_id }
output "ip_address" { value = module.jellyfin.ip_address }
output "ssh_command" { value = module.jellyfin.ssh_command }
output "urls" {
  value = {
    jellyfin  = { internal = module.jellyfin_route.internal_url, public = module.jellyfin_route.public_url }
    jellystat = { internal = module.jellystat_route.internal_url }
    requests  = { internal = module.requests_route.internal_url, public = module.requests_route.public_url }
  }
}

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # GPU passthrough disabled - add back later when GPU is configured:
    # group_add:
    #   - "109"  # render group for GPU access
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:latest
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:latest
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:

    19→  node_name   = var.proxmox_node
    20→  vm_id       = var.container_id
    21→  description = var.description
    22→  tags        = var.tags

    47→  dynamic "mount_point" {
    48→    for_each = var.mount_points

  rootfs_size    = 32

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)

  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["jellyfin"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["jellyfin"].edge_key

  # Note: Mount point for /data/library must be added manually via Proxmox SSH
  # The API token doesn't have permission to add bind mounts (requires root@pam)

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:latest
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:

content.text:
Wait - Jellyfin has its `.env` committed directly, not generated via template. Looking at the main.tf, I see it uses `portainer_edge_id/key` from the module which will generate a separate `.env` via the docker-lxc module. This will overwrite the existing `.env` with just the Edge credentials and lose the Jellystat credentials.

I need to handle this similar to how we did Obsidian Sync - generate a combined `.env` file. Let me check how Jellyfin's env file is handled and create a proper solution:

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# Docker Compose automatically loads .env files for variable substitution.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container as .env (Docker Compose auto-loads this)
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

content.text:
I see the issue. The docker-lxc module creates a `.env` file with ONLY Edge credentials when `portainer_edge_id/key` are provided. This will overwrite the existing `.env` with Jellystat credentials.

For Jellyfin, I have two options:
1. NOT pass `portainer_edge_id/key` to the module and handle `.env` generation separately (like Obsidian Sync)
2. Merge both credentials into one file

Since Jellyfin has its `.env` committed directly (not generated via templatefile), I'll take the same approach as Obsidian Sync - generate a combined `.env` file in the app's main.tf and NOT pass Edge credentials to the module.

# =============================================================================
# Immich LXC - Photo & Video Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 304
# IP: 192.168.1.222
#
# Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features and GPU acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 18
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 6144
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for mobile app)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for GPU access
  unprivileged = false

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Immich"
  service_description = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** Docker volumes (immich_pgdata)

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```bash
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f immich_server
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```bash
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Database Backup

Backup script runs pre-backup hook for Proxmox vzdump.
Manual backup:
```bash
cd /config && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall -U postgres > backup.sql
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["photos", "immich", "media"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "photos"
  backend_url = "http://${module.immich.ip_address}:2283"

  internal_domain = "photos.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "photos.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.immich]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.immich.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.immich.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.immich.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.immich_route.internal_url
    public   = module.immich_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.immich_route.remote_config_path
}

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  model-cache:

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  model-cache:

content.text:
Looking at the Jellyfin configuration, I see the mount points were **not** added via OpenTofu either - they have the same comment:

```hcl
# Note: Mount point for /data/library must be added manually via Proxmox SSH
# The API token doesn't have permission to add bind mounts (requires root@pam)
# Run this after container creation:
# ssh root@homelab "pct set 401 -mp0 /tank/data/library,mp=/data/library"
mount_points = []
```

The difference is:

1. **Jellyfin** - I ran `pct set 401 -mp0 /tank/data/library,mp=/data/library` **after** the container was created (the error occurred during `tofu apply` when mount_points was still populated in the config)

2. **Immich** - The error happened because I initially had `mount_points = [...]` in the config, which OpenTofu tried to set during container creation via the API token. The API token doesn't have `root@pam` privileges needed for bind mounts.

After I removed the mount_points from the Immich config (`mount_points = []`), the container created successfully. Then I added the mounts manually via SSH (which I shouldn't have done without permission).

So both apps have the same pattern now:
- `mount_points = []` in OpenTofu config
- Manual `pct set` command documented in comments
- Mounts added via SSH after container creation

The root cause is the Proxmox API token permission limitation - bind mounts require `root@pam` authentication, not API tokens.

content.text:
Yes, exactly. The Proxmox API enforces different permission levels:

- **API Token** (`opentofu@pam!opentofu`) - Can create containers, configure most settings, but **cannot** create bind mounts (security restriction)
- **root@pam** - Full privileges including bind mounts

If you switched to `root@pam` credentials (username/password auth) in the Proxmox provider configuration, the `mount_points` would work directly in OpenTofu.

However, there are trade-offs:

**Using root@pam:**
- ✅ Bind mounts work in OpenTofu
- ✅ No manual `pct set` commands needed
- ❌ Requires storing root password (less secure than API tokens)
- ❌ Can't use fine-grained permissions

**Current approach (API token + manual mounts):**
- ✅ API token with limited scope (principle of least privilege)
- ✅ Token can be revoked without changing passwords
- ❌ Requires manual `pct set` for bind mounts after container creation

A middle ground would be using a `null_resource` with SSH to add mounts declaratively after container creation - keeping the API token for most operations but using SSH for the privileged mount operation. That way it's still in OpenTofu state and repeatable.

Would you like me to implement that approach - a `null_resource` that runs the `pct set` commands via SSH after container creation?
yes! we should already have some null resource setup to run pct for things like setting features on lxc. it should have been part of the lxc-base module unless we removed it

content.text:
I see the pattern. The module already has `mount_points` variable and a `dynamic "mount_point"` block, but that goes through the API which fails for bind mounts. We need to add a `null_resource` similar to `configure_gpu_passthrough` that configures mount points via SSH.

I'll add a new `null_resource.configure_mount_points` that runs `pct set` commands via SSH for bind mounts:

input.new_string:
# Configure bind mount points via SSH to Proxmox host
# The API token cannot set bind mounts - requires root@pam
# This uses pct set to add mount points after container creation
resource "null_resource" "configure_mount_points" {
  count = length(var.mount_points) > 0 && var.proxmox_ssh_host != "" ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [
    proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc,
    null_resource.configure_container_features,
    null_resource.configure_gpu_passthrough
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    mount_points = jsonencode(var.mount_points)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    connection {
      type        = "ssh"
      host        = var.proxmox_ssh_host
      user        = "root"
      private_key = file(var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path)
    }

    inline = concat(
      # Stop container before adding mount points
      ["if pct status ${var.container_id} | grep -q running; then pct stop ${var.container_id}; sleep 2; fi"],

      # Add each mount point via pct set
      [for mp in var.mount_points : "pct set ${var.container_id} -mp${mp.slot} ${mp.volume},mp=${mp.path}"],

      # Start container
      ["pct start ${var.container_id}"],

      # Wait for container to get IP
      ["echo 'Waiting for container to get IP...'"],
      ["for i in $(seq 1 15); do IP=$(pct exec ${var.container_id} -- ip -4 addr show eth0 2>/dev/null | grep inet | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d/ -f1); if [ -n \"$IP\" ] && [ \"$IP\" != \"pending\" ]; then echo \"Got IP: $IP\"; break; fi; sleep 2; done"],

      ["echo 'Mount points configured for container ${var.container_id}: ${join(", ", [for mp in var.mount_points : mp.path])}'"]
    )
  }
}

# Wait for container to get DHCP IP
resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_ip" {
  depends_on = [
    proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc,
    null_resource.configure_container_features,
    null_resource.configure_gpu_passthrough,
    null_resource.configure_mount_points
  ]
  create_duration = "15s"
}

# =============================================================================
# Portainer LXC - Container Management UI
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 100
# Container IP: 10.100.1.100 (container network)
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Central management UI for all Docker containers across the homelab.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 100
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "portainer" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "portainer"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.portainer}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Portainer"
  service_description = "Central Docker container management UI with Watchtower auto-updates"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://portainer.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.core.portainer}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Portainer", port = 9000, info = "Container management UI" },
    { name = "Edge Agent Tunnel", port = 8000, info = "Edge agent communication" },
    { name = "Watchtower", port = 0, info = "Automatic container updates (daily)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f portainer
cd /config && docker compose logs -f watchtower
```

**Manual Watchtower run:**
```
docker exec watchtower /watchtower --run-once
```

## Agents

All app LXCs run Portainer Agent on port 9001 for centralized management.

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=portainer` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["portainer", "management", "watchtower"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "portainer_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "portainer"
  backend_url = "http://${module.portainer.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "portainer.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.portainer]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.portainer.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.portainer.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.portainer.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.portainer_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.portainer.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.portainer_route.remote_config_path
}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer CE - Container Management UI
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    container_name: portainer
    command: -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"   # Web UI
      - "8000:8000"   # Edge agent tunnel
    volumes:
      - ./portainer:/data
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Watchtower - Automatic Container Updates
  # ==========================================================================
  watchtower:
    image: containrrr/watchtower:latest
    container_name: watchtower
    environment:
      - WATCHTOWER_CLEANUP=true
      - WATCHTOWER_POLL_INTERVAL=86400  # Check daily
      - WATCHTOWER_INCLUDE_RESTARTING=true
      - WATCHTOWER_LABEL_ENABLE=true    # Only update containers with label
      - DOCKER_API_VERSION=1.52         # Match Docker daemon API version
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    restart: unless-stopped

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"        # HTTP
      - "443:443"      # HTTPS
      - "8082:8082"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config (synced by docker-host module to /config/static/)
      - /config/static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs (synced by docker-host module to /config/dynamic/)
      - /config/dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (Docker volume for persistence across restarts)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs (Docker volume)
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:latest
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"
