# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
# IP: 192.168.1.235
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.traefik_ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = "darshanrambhia@live.com"
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Media Management LXC - Download & Library Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 402
# IP: 192.168.1.227
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Download clients and library managers with VPN protection.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 402
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Media Management Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "media_management" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "media-management"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.media_management}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for VPN TUN device access
  unprivileged = false

  # Mount data directory (for hardlinks to work)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data"
      volume = "/tank/data"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Media Management"
  service_description = "Download clients and library managers with VPN protection"

  service_urls = {
    qbittorrent = "https://qbittorrent.${var.domain_internal}"
    sonarr      = "https://sonarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    radarr      = "https://radarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    lidarr      = "https://lidarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    prowlarr    = "https://prowlarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    bazarr      = "https://bazarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    sabnzbd     = "https://sabnzbd.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Gluetun", port = 0, info = "VPN gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)" },
    { name = "qBittorrent", port = 8080, info = "BitTorrent client (via VPN)" },
    { name = "SABnzbd", port = 8085, info = "Usenet download client" },
    { name = "Prowlarr", port = 9696, info = "Indexer manager (via VPN)" },
    { name = "FlareSolverr", port = 8191, info = "Cloudflare bypass (via VPN)" },
    { name = "Sonarr", port = 8989, info = "TV show management" },
    { name = "Radarr", port = 7878, info = "Movie management" },
    { name = "Lidarr", port = 8686, info = "Music management" },
    { name = "Bazarr", port = 6767, info = "Subtitle management" },
    { name = "Recyclarr", port = 0, info = "TRaSH Guides sync (scheduled)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage (TRaSH Guides Compliant)

**Data Directory:** `/data` (mounted from `/tank/data`)
- `/data/torrents/movies` - Movie downloads
- `/data/torrents/tv` - TV show downloads
- `/data/torrents/music` - Music downloads
- `/data/library/movies` - Movie library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/tv` - TV show library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/music` - Music library (hardlinks from downloads)

## VPN Protection

All torrent traffic routes through Gluetun (NordVPN WireGuard):
- qBittorrent, Prowlarr, FlareSolverr use VPN network
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr use host network

**Check VPN status:**
```bash
docker exec gluetun wget -qO- ifconfig.me
```

## Quick Commands

**View all logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart VPN:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart gluetun
```

**Check qBittorrent connectivity:**
```bash
docker exec qbittorrent curl -s ifconfig.me
```

## TRaSH Guides Sync

Recyclarr runs on schedule to sync quality profiles:
```bash
docker exec recyclarr recyclarr sync
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=media-management` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["media", "downloads", "arr"]
}

  app_name    = "qbittorrent"

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each Edge environment in Portainer has unique credentials stored in 1Password.
# Item format: "portainer-edge-<app-name>" with fields:
#   - edge_id: UUID for the Edge environment
#   - edge_key: Base64-encoded connection key
#
# Create items in 1Password:
#   op item create --category=login --title="portainer-edge-dashboards" \
#     --vault=homelab edge_id=<uuid> edge_key=<base64-key>

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }

  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  # Each entry has .edge_id and .edge_key
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      # Include top-level fields (username/password/etc)
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      # Include section fields
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }
}

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"        # HTTP
      - "443:443"      # HTTPS
      - "8082:8082"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config (synced by docker-host module to /config/static/)
      - /config/static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs (synced by docker-host module to /config/dynamic/)
      - /config/dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (Docker volume for persistence across restarts)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs (Docker volume)
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:latest
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:latest
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    container_name: radarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:latest
    container_name: lidarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:latest
    container_name: bazarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:latest
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sabnzbd-config:/config
      - /data/usenet:/data/usenet
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Recyclarr - TRaSH Guides Sync
  # ==========================================================================
  recyclarr:
    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:latest
    container_name: recyclarr
    network_mode: host
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  gluetun-data:
  qbittorrent-config:
  prowlarr-config:
  sonarr-config:
  radarr-config:
  lidarr-config:
  bazarr-config:
  sabnzbd-config:

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:

    restart: unless-stopped

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
# IP: 192.168.1.235
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.traefik_ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = "darshanrambhia@live.com"
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
# IP: 192.168.1.235
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.traefik_ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = "darshanrambhia@live.com"
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 402
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Media Management Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "media_management" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "media-management"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.media_management}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for VPN TUN device access
  unprivileged = false

  # Mount data directory (for hardlinks to work)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data"
      volume = "/tank/data"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Media Management"
  service_description = "Download clients and library managers with VPN protection"

  service_urls = {
    qbittorrent = "https://qbittorrent.${var.domain_internal}"
    sonarr      = "https://sonarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    radarr      = "https://radarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    lidarr      = "https://lidarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    prowlarr    = "https://prowlarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    bazarr      = "https://bazarr.${var.domain_internal}"
    sabnzbd     = "https://sabnzbd.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Gluetun", port = 0, info = "VPN gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)" },
    { name = "qBittorrent", port = 8080, info = "BitTorrent client (via VPN)" },
    { name = "SABnzbd", port = 8085, info = "Usenet download client" },
    { name = "Prowlarr", port = 9696, info = "Indexer manager (via VPN)" },
    { name = "FlareSolverr", port = 8191, info = "Cloudflare bypass (via VPN)" },
    { name = "Sonarr", port = 8989, info = "TV show management" },
    { name = "Radarr", port = 7878, info = "Movie management" },
    { name = "Lidarr", port = 8686, info = "Music management" },
    { name = "Bazarr", port = 6767, info = "Subtitle management" },
    { name = "Recyclarr", port = 0, info = "TRaSH Guides sync (scheduled)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage (TRaSH Guides Compliant)

**Data Directory:** `/data` (mounted from `/tank/data`)
- `/data/torrents/movies` - Movie downloads
- `/data/torrents/tv` - TV show downloads
- `/data/torrents/music` - Music downloads
- `/data/library/movies` - Movie library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/tv` - TV show library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/music` - Music library (hardlinks from downloads)

## VPN Protection

All torrent traffic routes through Gluetun (NordVPN WireGuard):
- qBittorrent, Prowlarr, FlareSolverr use VPN network
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr use host network

**Check VPN status:**
```bash
docker exec gluetun wget -qO- ifconfig.me
```

## Quick Commands

**View all logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart VPN:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart gluetun
```

**Check qBittorrent connectivity:**
```bash
docker exec qbittorrent curl -s ifconfig.me
```

## TRaSH Guides Sync

Recyclarr runs on schedule to sync quality profiles:
```bash
docker exec recyclarr recyclarr sync
```

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
# IP: 192.168.1.229
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://192.168.1.229:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://192.168.1.229:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = "darshan"
    uptime_kuma_password   = "nax9wzw8xqn1vpu*RME"
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each Edge environment in Portainer has unique credentials stored in 1Password.
# Item format: "portainer-edge-<app-name>" with fields:
#   - edge_id: UUID for the Edge environment
#   - edge_key: Base64-encoded connection key
#
# Create items in 1Password:
#   op item create --category=login --title="portainer-edge-dashboards" \
#     --vault=homelab edge_id=<uuid> edge_key=<base64-key>

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
    "traefik",
    "network-services",
    "media-management",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }

  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  # Each entry has .edge_id and .edge_key
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      # Include top-level fields (username/password/etc)
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      # Include section fields
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }
}

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {

  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

data "onepassword_item" "uptime_kuma" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "uptime-kuma"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each Edge environment in Portainer has unique credentials stored in 1Password.
# Item format: "portainer-edge-<app-name>" with fields:
#   - edge_id: UUID for the Edge environment
#   - edge_key: Base64-encoded connection key
#
# Create items in 1Password:
#   op item create --category=login --title="portainer-edge-dashboards" \
#     --vault=homelab edge_id=<uuid> edge_key=<base64-key>

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
    "traefik",
    "network-services",
    "media-management",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }

  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  # Each entry has .edge_id and .edge_key
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      # Include top-level fields (username/password/etc)
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      # Include section fields
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }
}

# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
# IP: 192.168.1.235
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.traefik_ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token       = local.op.cloudflare_api_token

    portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["traefik"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["traefik"].edge_key

}

output "ip_address" {

  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"        # HTTP
      - "443:443"      # HTTPS
      - "8082:8082"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config (synced by docker-host module to /config/static/)
      - /config/static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs (synced by docker-host module to /config/dynamic/)
      - /config/dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (Docker volume for persistence across restarts)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs (Docker volume)
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-traefik
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenWebUI - AI Chat Interface
  # ==========================================================================
  openwebui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    container_name: openwebui
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://ollama:11434
      - WEBUI_AUTH=true
      - WEBUI_NAME=Homelab AI
      - ENABLE_SIGNUP=false  # Security: Disable public signup
      - DEFAULT_MODELS=llama3.2:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./openwebui:/app/backend/data
    depends_on:
      - ollama
    # DNS settings for external resolution
    dns:
      - 8.8.8.8
      - 1.1.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Ollama - Local LLM Backend (AMD GPU Accelerated)
  # ==========================================================================
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:rocm
    container_name: ollama
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=http://localhost,http://openwebui,https://ai.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"
    volumes:
      # Reuse existing Ollama data (32GB of models) from native install
      - /root/.ollama:/root/.ollama
    # AMD GPU passthrough via ROCM
    devices:
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Secure container management
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-openwebui
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

Both PVE and PBS use HTTPS backends with self-signed certificates. If we disable `insecureSkipVerify` globally, these will break. The better approach is to:

1. Remove the global `insecureSkipVerify`
2. Create specific serversTransports for backends that need it (like PVE/PBS)

Let me update the configuration:

input.new_string:

serversTransport:
  insecureSkipVerify: false

# Common Traefik middlewares for homelab
http:
  middlewares:
    security-headers:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        forceSTSHeader: true
        stsIncludeSubdomains: true
        stsPreload: true
        stsSeconds: 31536000
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    public-security:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    # Internal-only: Allow only local network and Tailscale
    internal-only:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "192.168.1.0/24"    # Local LAN
          - "100.64.0.0/10"     # Tailscale CGNAT range
          - "127.0.0.1/32"      # Localhost

    # Authelia forward auth middleware
    authelia:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://10.100.2.202:9091/api/authz/forward-auth"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - "Remote-User"
          - "Remote-Groups"
          - "Remote-Email"
          - "Remote-Name"

content.text:
I see! Watchtower is configured with `WATCHTOWER_LABEL_ENABLE=true` which means it only updates containers that have the label `com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true`. Looking at the configs, the labels are already on select containers.

The current setup is actually reasonable - Watchtower only updates containers that explicitly opt-in via labels. However, if we're pinning images, we should:
1. Pin the versions
2. Remove the Watchtower labels OR keep them and let Watchtower update within pinned minor versions

For now, let me change the approach: instead of disabling Watchtower entirely, I'll configure it to "monitor only" mode (notifies but doesn't update). This gives visibility into available updates while maintaining control:

# ==========================================================================
  # Watchtower - Container Update Monitoring (Monitor-Only Mode)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Configured in monitor-only mode: checks for updates but doesn't apply them.
  # This provides visibility into available updates while maintaining control.
  watchtower:
    image: containrrr/watchtower:1.7.1
    container_name: watchtower
    environment:
      - WATCHTOWER_MONITOR_ONLY=true    # Don't auto-update, just notify
      - WATCHTOWER_CLEANUP=true
      - WATCHTOWER_POLL_INTERVAL=86400  # Check daily
      - WATCHTOWER_INCLUDE_RESTARTING=true
      - DOCKER_API_VERSION=1.52         # Match Docker daemon API version
      - TZ=America/New_York

# Authelia - Centralized Authentication
# https://www.authelia.com/

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key
      # OIDC env vars - uncomment when enabling OIDC clients
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_HMAC_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/oidc_hmac_secret
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE: /secrets/oidc_private_key
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-authelia
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:
  portainer_agent_data:
