services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:latest
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:latest
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.11-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:latest
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-network-services
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (VA-API)
    group_add:
      - "44"   # video group for GPU access
      - "104"  # render group for GPU access
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:latest
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:latest
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-jellyfin
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # SABnzbd
      - "8085:8085"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:latest
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    container_name: radarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:latest
    container_name: lidarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:latest
    container_name: bazarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:latest
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sabnzbd-config:/config
      - /data/usenet:/data/usenet
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Recyclarr - TRaSH Guides Sync
  # ==========================================================================
  recyclarr:
    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:latest
    container_name: recyclarr
    network_mode: host
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-media-management
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  gluetun-data:
  qbittorrent-config:
  prowlarr-config:
  sonarr-config:
  radarr-config:
  lidarr-config:
  bazarr-config:
  sabnzbd-config:
  portainer_agent_data:

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    portainer_key  = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "portainer_key", "")
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=${local.homepage_env.portainer_key}

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=${local.homepage_env.adguard_pass}

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=${local.homepage_env.immich_key}

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyfin_key}

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.jellyseerr_key}

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sonarr_key}

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=${local.homepage_env.radarr_key}

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=${local.homepage_env.sabnzbd_key}

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=${local.homepage_env.qbit_user}
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=${local.homepage_env.qbit_pass}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["dashboards"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure homepage.env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.homepage_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["dashboards", "homepage", "dashy", "monitoring"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Homepage route (internal only)
module "homepage_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "homepage"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "homepage.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = module.homepage_route.internal_url
    dashy_internal    = module.dashy_route.internal_url
    dashy_public      = module.dashy_route.public_url
    direct_homepage   = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"
    direct_dashy      = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    homepage = module.homepage_route.remote_config_path
    dashy    = module.dashy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

data "onepassword_item" "uptime_kuma" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "uptime-kuma"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each Edge environment in Portainer has unique credentials stored in 1Password.
# Item format: "portainer-edge-<app-name>" with fields:
#   - edge_id: UUID for the Edge environment
#   - edge_key: Base64-encoded connection key
#
# Create items in 1Password:
#   op item create --category=login --title="portainer-edge-dashboards" \
#     --vault=homelab edge_id=<uuid> edge_key=<base64-key>

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
    "traefik",
    "network-services",
    "media-management",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare (custom fields in sections + standard fields)
    cloudflare_email        = data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.username
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password  = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url     = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
    uptime_kuma_username    = data.onepassword_item.uptime_kuma.username
    uptime_kuma_password    = data.onepassword_item.uptime_kuma.password
  }

  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  # Each entry has .edge_id and .edge_key
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      # Include top-level fields (username/password/etc)
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      # Include section fields
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }
}

1→# =============================================================================
     2→# IP Address Registry
     3→# =============================================================================
     4→# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
     5→# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
     6→#
     7→# Network Architecture:
     8→#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
     9→#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
    10→#
    11→# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
    12→#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
    13→#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
    14→#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
    15→#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
    16→#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
    17→#
    18→# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
    19→#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
    20→#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
    21→#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
    22→#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
    23→# =============================================================================
    24→
    25→locals {
    26→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27→  # Network Configuration
    28→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29→  network = {
    30→    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    31→    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    32→    lan_netmask = "/24"
    33→    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"
    34→
    35→    # Container network (vmbr1)
    36→    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    37→    container_netmask = "/16"
    38→    container_prefix  = "10.100"
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42→  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
    43→  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44→  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
    45→  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)
    46→
    47→  ip_registry = {
    48→    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    49→    infrastructure = {
    50→      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
    51→      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
    52→      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    56→    core = {
    57→      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
    58→      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
    59→      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    63→    dashboards = {

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

The official Docker image can be pulled using `stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest`. Alternatively, you can also use `docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf`.

Stirling-PDF offers three versions depending on your needs, and most users should use `latest` - it has everything you need.

docker run -p 8080:8080 stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest

Then open http://localhost:8080 in your browser.

# =============================================================================

#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services

#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  container_ips = {

    # Photos (300-349)

    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

data "onepassword_item" "uptime_kuma" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "uptime-kuma"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each Edge environment in Portainer has unique credentials stored in 1Password.
# Item format: "portainer-edge-<app-name>" with fields:
#   - edge_id: UUID for the Edge environment
#   - edge_key: Base64-encoded connection key
#
# Create items in 1Password:
#   op item create --category=login --title="portainer-edge-dashboards" \
#     --vault=homelab edge_id=<uuid> edge_key=<base64-key>

data "onepassword_item" "portainer_edge" {
  for_each = toset([
    "dashboards",
    "authelia",
    "monitoring",
    "obsidian-sync",
    "jellyfin",
    "immich",
    "n8n",
    "openwebui",
    "traefik",
    "network-services",
    "media-management",
  ])

  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "portainer-edge-${each.key}"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare (custom fields in sections + standard fields)
    cloudflare_email        = data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.username
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password  = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url     = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
    uptime_kuma_username    = data.onepassword_item.uptime_kuma.username
    uptime_kuma_password    = data.onepassword_item.uptime_kuma.password
  }

  # Portainer Edge credentials - access via local.portainer_edge["app-name"]
  # Each entry has .edge_id and .edge_key
  portainer_edge = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => {
      edge_id  = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_id", "")
      edge_key = lookup(local._portainer_edge_fields[name], "edge_key", "")
    }
  }

  # Helper to flatten Portainer Edge item fields
  _portainer_edge_fields = {
    for name, item in data.onepassword_item.portainer_edge : name => merge(
      # Include top-level fields (username/password/etc)
      {
        "edge_id"  = try(item.username, "")
        "edge_key" = try(item.password, "")
      },
      # Include section fields
      merge([
        for s in try(item.section, []) : {
          for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
        }
      ]...)
    )
  }
}

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.14.7
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:7.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:0.35.1
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab

  paperless:

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {

locals {

      for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {

      }

    admin_password = local._paperless_fields.admin_password

    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_fields, "secret_key", "")

input.command:
# Generate random passwords/keys
db_password=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 32)
secret_key=$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 50)

# Create paperless item in 1Password
op item create --category=login --title="paperless" --vault=homelab \
  'username=admin' \
  "password=$(openssl rand -base64 16 | tr -d '/+=')" \
  "db_password[password]=$db_password" \
  "secret_key[password]=$secret_key" \
  --format=json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.id'

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# Docker Compose automatically loads .env files for variable substitution.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container as .env (Docker Compose auto-loads this)
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless fields
  _paperless_fields = merge(
    {
      admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
      admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    },
    merge([
      for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
        for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
      }
    ]...)
  )

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = local._paperless_fields.admin_user
    admin_password = local._paperless_fields.admin_password
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}
