    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password)
  portainer_edge_id  = local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id
  portainer_edge_key = local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless fields (all fields are top-level in this item)
  _paperless_top_fields = {
    for f in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.field, []) : f.label => f.value
  }

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_top_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_top_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: Do NOT pass portainer_edge_id/key here - we handle the combined .env file
  # ourselves (including both paperless secrets AND portainer credentials).
  # The module's portainer env feature only supports portainer-only env files.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

content.text:
To answer your question about Gmail plus addressing:

**Yes, Paperless will have access to your entire inbox** when you use `youremail+paperless@gmail.com` as credentials.

Here's why: Gmail plus addressing (`+paperless`) is just a routing alias - all emails to `youremail+paperless@gmail.com` land in the same inbox as `youremail@gmail.com`. When Paperless connects via IMAP with your credentials, it sees **everything** in that inbox, not just emails sent to the +paperless alias.

**The solution** is to use Gmail filters + IMAP folder targeting:

1. **Create a Gmail filter**:
   - Go to Gmail Settings → Filters → Create new filter
   - Set "To" field: `youremail+paperless@gmail.com`
   - Action: Apply label "Paperless" (or skip inbox & apply label)

2. **Configure Paperless to only check that folder**:
   ```yaml
   - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_IMAP_FOLDER=Paperless
   ```

This way, only emails you explicitly send to `+paperless` get processed - your regular inbox stays untouched.

2. Add the IMAP environment variables to Paperless

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

**Step 1: Create a Gmail App Password**

Now add the email fields to the 1Password item. You'll need to provide your Gmail address and the App Password:

```bash
op item edit paperless --vault=homelab \
  'email_host_user[text]=youremail+paperless@gmail.com' \
  'email_host_password[password]=YOUR_16_CHAR_APP_PASSWORD'
```

**Step 3: Set up a Gmail filter**

Go to Gmail → Settings → Filters → Create new filter:
- **To:** `youremail+paperless@gmail.com`
- **Action:** Apply label "Paperless", Skip Inbox (optional)

This way only emails sent to your +paperless alias get processed.

Paperless is running and healthy. The email configuration is loaded via environment variables - Paperless-ngx doesn't log the email settings explicitly, it just uses them when fetching emails.

**Important**: The environment variables alone don't create email accounts in Paperless. You need to configure a **Mail Rule** in the Paperless admin UI that tells it which folder to check and what to do with the emails.

Go to **https://docs.rambtech.dev** → **Admin** → **Mail** → **Mail Accounts** and create:

1. **Mail Account**:
   - Name: `Gmail`
   - IMAP Server: `imap.gmail.com`
   - IMAP Port: `993`
   - IMAP Security: `SSL`
   - Username: `ddj333+paperless@gmail.com`
   - Password: (your app password)

2. **Mail Rule**:
   - Name: `Import all attachments`
   - Account: `Gmail`
   - Folder: `INBOX` (or `Paperless` if you set up a Gmail filter)
   - Action: `Mark as read` or `Delete`
   - Attachment type: `Everything` or `Only attachments with PDF`

Wait - I just realized the environment variables are the **legacy** way to configure email. The modern Paperless-ngx (v2.x) uses the **admin UI** for mail configuration instead. The env vars I added might be ignored.

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR

  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
      # Email consumption (Gmail IMAP)
      # Paperless checks this mailbox and imports attachments as documents
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_TASK_CRON=*/10 * * * *
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST=${PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST:-imap.gmail.com}
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_PORT=${PAPERLESS_EMAIL_PORT:-993}
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_USER=${PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_USER}
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_EMAIL_USE_SSL=true
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:7.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.3
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-documents
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.24.1
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:
  portainer_agent_data:

# =============================================================================

# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
    # Email consumption (Gmail IMAP)
    email_host_user     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "email_host_user", "")
    email_host_password = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "email_host_password", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Email Consumption (Gmail IMAP)
PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_USER=${local.paperless.email_host_user}
PAPERLESS_EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.email_host_password}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

proxmox-homelab-z80: Remove Portainer Agent port 9001 exposure from all containers
Status: closed
Priority: P2
Type: task
Created: 2025-12-14 04:30
Updated: 2025-12-14 15:34

Description:
CRITICAL SECURITY: Replace Portainer Agent port 9001 exposure with Edge Agents.

## Current Problem
All 12 docker-compose files expose port 9001 with Docker socket access:
```yaml
portainer-agent:
  ports:
    - "9001:9001"  # Exposed to all interfaces
  volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
```

## Solution: Portainer Edge Agents
Edge Agents dial OUT to Portainer (no listening ports needed).

### Implementation Steps

1. **Enable Edge Compute in Portainer (LXC 100)**
   - Settings → Edge Compute → Enable Edge Compute
   - Note the Portainer URL and port (default :8000 for tunnel)

2. **Create Edge Environment for each LXC**
   - Environments → Add Environment → Edge Agent
   - Copy the EDGE_ID and EDGE_KEY for each

3. **Update all docker-compose files**
   Replace portainer-agent with:
   ```yaml
   portainer-edge-agent:
     image: portainer/agent:latest
     container_name: portainer_edge_agent
     environment:
       EDGE: 1
       EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
       EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
       EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 0
     volumes:
       - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
       - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
       - portainer_agent_data:/data
     restart: unless-stopped
     # NO PORTS EXPOSED
   ```

4. **Store Edge credentials in 1Password**
   - Create item per LXC: portainer-edge-{lxc-name}
   - Fields: edge_id, edge_key

5. **Update OpenTofu to inject Edge credentials**
   - Add to onepassword.tf
   - Pass to docker-compose via .env

### Files to Modify
- tofu/apps/portainer/deploy/docker-compose.yml (Portainer server config)
- tofu/apps/*/deploy/docker-compose.yml (all 12 apps)
- tofu/onepassword.tf (Edge credentials)
- tofu/modules/docker-lxc/variables.tf (Edge vars)

### Benefits
- No listening ports on any LXC (except Portainer :8000)
- Agents initiate outbound connection
- Works through firewalls
- Free with Portainer CE
- Maintains LXC isolation

### Rollback Plan
If Edge Agents don't work well, can fall back to internal IP binding:
```yaml
ports:
  - "${LXC_IP}:9001:9001"
```

  → proxmox-homelab-pk3: Epic: Critical Security Fixes (Week 1) [P2]

     container_name: portainer_edge_agent
     environment:
       EDGE: 1
       EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
       EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
       EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 0
     volumes:
       - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
       - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
       - portainer_agent_data:/data
     restart: unless-stopped
     # NO PORTS EXPOSED
   ```

4. **Store Edge credentials in 1Password**
   - Create item per LXC: portainer-edge-{lxc-name}
   - Fields: edge_id, edge_key

5. **Update OpenTofu to inject Edge credentials**
   - Add to onepassword.tf
   - Pass to docker-compose via .env

### Files to Modify
- tofu/apps/portainer/deploy/docker-compose.yml (Portainer server config)
- tofu/apps/*/deploy/docker-compose.yml (all 12 apps)
- tofu/onepassword.tf (Edge credentials)
- tofu/modules/docker-lxc/variables.tf (Edge vars)

### Benefits
- No listening ports on any LXC (except Portainer :8000)
- Agents initiate outbound connection
- Works through firewalls
- Free with Portainer CE
- Maintains LXC isolation

### Rollback Plan
If Edge Agents don't work well, can fall back to internal IP binding:
```yaml
ports:
  - "${LXC_IP}:9001:9001"
```
